detection_efficiency.rule: occurrence of the permanent-lake core (largest occ>=90 component eroded by 8 px) / 100

grid.domain_rule: radar footprint valid on all 10 dates (math products) and >= 50 % valid GSW

levels.source: G-REALM lake000319 (NASA GSFC Global Water Monitor / USDA FAS), EGM2008 heights

range_from: zoned: corridor at Prek Kdam-equivalent level
expected_km2.area_rule: sum over cells of the fraction of 30 m pixels with occurrence >= o_t

hypsometry.kummu_source: Kummu et al. (2014) Hydrol. Process. 28:1722-1733, as printed in Chua et al. (2022) HESS 26:609-625 Eq. 18
hypsometry.offset_rule: mean of (altimeter mean annual min/max) - (Kampong Luong min/max reported by Chua et al. 2022) over 1996-2009 and 2010-2019

dem_check.floodplain_rule: domain, not the permanent lake component, not the flattened DEM lake value, 1 <= occurrence < 90

bathtub.seed: largest connected component of GSW occurrence >= 90 % (the permanent lake)
bathtub.dem: Copernicus GLO-90 on our grid (EGM2008 heights; a surface model)

per_terrain_rule.rule: water = water(0.06/0.12) OR (water(weak 0.202, strong weak/2) AND inside GSW maximum extent)
